sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Casterwill's first son fought alongside his family in the great war against the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

Using Umbra, the Titan of Dimensions, he and his siblings teleported to the Spiral Mark where he watched Lord Casterwill seal the Mark using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the death of Lord Casterwill, on the longest night of the year, he and his siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him from using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: The elder son was a powerful and valiant Seeker who fought bravely against the [[Nullifiers]].

full_text:
The elder son of Casterwill was one of Lord Casterwill's children and the previous Seeker to be bonded to Umbra, the Legendary Titan of Dimensions.

== History ==
Casterwill's first son fought alongside his family in the great war against the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

Using Umbra, the Titan of Dimensions, he and his siblings teleported to the Spiral Mark where he watched Lord Casterwill seal the Mark using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the death of Lord Casterwill, on the longest night of the year, he and his siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him from using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]
==Abilities==
The elder son was a powerful and valiant Seeker who fought bravely against the Nullifiers.
===Bonded Titans===
